DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのお荷物をお送りになるのですね。宛名ラベルを確認してもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like to send this parcel, correct? May I check the address label?

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: どうぞ見てください。角の部分がはがれてきたので気になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 宛名ラベルの角がはがれていることを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Please do. I'm concerned because one corner is starting to peel off.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the peeling corner of the address label. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 端が浮いていますね。文字にかからないよう、貼り直せるか見てみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The edge is lifting, yes. Let's see whether we can secure it again without covering the writing.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 上から全部テープで覆うより、端だけ押さえたほうがよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 全面を覆うか端を押さえるか固定方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Would it be better to secure just the edges instead of covering the whole label with tape?
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether to cover the whole label or secure its edges. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 読み取りに影響しない貼り方を確認します。まず、この浮いている部分を平らにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check a way of attaching it that won't interfere with scanning. First, please flatten this raised part.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: しわを伸ばしました。宛先の郵便番号が欠けていないかも見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: しわを伸ばして郵便番号の欠けの確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've smoothed out the wrinkles. Could you also check whether any digits of the destination postcode are missing?
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Smooth out the wrinkles and ask them to check that the postcode is complete. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 七桁の数字は見えていますが、送り先の住所とご自身でも照合してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I can see seven digits, but please compare them with the recipient's address yourself as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 注文メールの住所と数字が一致しています。建物名も最後まで印刷されています。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 注文メールと宛先が一致し建物名も印刷されていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: The address and digits match the order email. The building name is also printed all the way to the end.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that the destination matches the order email and the full building name is printed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、ラベルを固定してから受け付けます。差出人の連絡先はお書きになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then we'll secure the label before accepting the parcel. Have you written the sender's contact details?

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 裏面に私の住所と電話番号を書きました。固定できたらこの荷物をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 差出人情報の記入と固定後の発送希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've written my address and phone number on the back. Once the label is secure, please send this parcel.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have entered the sender's details and would like the parcel sent after the label is secured. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 状態を確認して受付を進めます。ご利用ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-HAMADA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll check its condition and continue processing it. Thank you for using our service.

DLG-SC-SMN-IZUMO-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SMN-IZUMO-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どなたのお守りをお探しでしょうか。
DLG-SC-SMN-IZUMO-001-SHARED-01.translation: Who are you looking for a protective charm for?

DLG-SC-SMN-IZUMO-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SMN-IZUMO-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 弟が来月から一人暮らしをするので、お守りを渡したいんです。
DLG-SC-SMN-IZUMO-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一人暮らしを始める弟に贈るお守りを探していると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SMN-IZUMO-001-SHARED-02.translation: My younger brother is going to start living on his own next month, so I'd like to give him a charm.
DLG-SC-SMN-IZUMO-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you are looking for a charm to give your younger brother as he starts living alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SMN-IZUMO-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SMN-IZUMO-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 新しい生活を願うものですと、こちらの二種類があります。
DLG-SC-SMN-IZUMO-001-SHARED-03.translation: For wishes relating to a new life, we have these two kinds.

DLG-SC-SMN-IZUMO-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SMN-IZUMO-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 青いほうと白いほうでは、願いの意味が違うのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-SMN-IZUMO-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 青と白のお守りで願いの意味が違うか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SMN-IZUMO-001-SHARED-04.translation: Do the blue one and the white one represent different wishes?
DLG-SC-SMN-IZUMO-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether the blue and white charms have different meanings. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SMN-IZUMO-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SMN-IZUMO-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの札では、青は健康、白は生活全般と説明しています。
DLG-SC-SMN-IZUMO-001-SHARED-05.translation: This sign explains that blue is for health and white is for life in general.

DLG-SC-SMN-IZUMO-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SMN-IZUMO-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 白を一体お願いします。かばんに付けるため、袋を開けてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-SMN-IZUMO-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 白のお守り一体を選び包装を開けてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SMN-IZUMO-001-SHARED-06.translation: One white charm, please. May I open the wrapping so it can be attached to a bag?
DLG-SC-SMN-IZUMO-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose one white charm and ask whether you may open the wrapping. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SMN-IZUMO-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SMN-IZUMO-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 外側の包装は外して構いませんが、お守り自体の中は開けずにお持ちください。
DLG-SC-SMN-IZUMO-001-SHARED-07.translation: You may remove the outer wrapping, but please keep the charm itself closed without opening its contents.

DLG-SC-SMN-IZUMO-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SMN-IZUMO-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 弟にその違いを説明します。渡すまで自宅のどこに置けばいいでしょう。
DLG-SC-SMN-IZUMO-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 包装と中身の扱いを理解し自宅での保管場所を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SMN-IZUMO-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll explain that difference to my brother. Where should I keep it at home until I give it to him?
DLG-SC-SMN-IZUMO-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show that you understand how to handle the wrapping and the charm itself, and ask about storage at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SMN-IZUMO-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SMN-IZUMO-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 踏んだり汚したりしない、清潔な場所で大切に保管なさってください。
DLG-SC-SMN-IZUMO-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please keep it carefully in a clean place where it won't be stepped on or get dirty.

DLG-SC-SMN-IZUMO-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SMN-IZUMO-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 机の引き出しを片付けて、そこにしまっておきます。包んでいただけますか。
DLG-SC-SMN-IZUMO-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 清潔にした引き出しで保管すると伝え包装を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SMN-IZUMO-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll tidy a drawer in my desk and keep it there. Could you wrap it for me?
DLG-SC-SMN-IZUMO-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will store it in a cleaned drawer and ask for it to be wrapped. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SMN-IZUMO-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SMN-IZUMO-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 白のお守りをお包みしました。弟様の新生活が穏やかでありますように、どうぞお気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-SMN-IZUMO-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've wrapped the white charm. May your brother's new life be peaceful. Have a safe journey home.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: そばのご注文を伺ってもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I take your soba order?

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 卵アレルギーがあります。割子そばの麺や薬味に卵は使われていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 卵アレルギーを伝え割子そばの麺と薬味の材料を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have an egg allergy. Is egg used in the noodles or garnishes for the warigo soba?
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your egg allergy and ask about the ingredients in the warigo soba noodles and garnishes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この麺と薬味の材料表には卵の記載はありませんが、厨房では卵料理も扱っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Egg isn't listed on the ingredients sheets for these noodles and garnishes, but we also prepare egg dishes in the kitchen.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 卵料理と同じ箸や器具を使うことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 卵料理との箸や調理器具の共用を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Do you ever use the same chopsticks or utensils as for the egg dishes?
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check whether chopsticks or cooking utensils are shared with egg dishes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 専用の器具とは分けきれておらず、卵が付く可能性を否定できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We cannot keep the utensils completely separate, so we can't rule out the possibility of egg getting onto them.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私には少量でも症状が出るので、そばは注文しません。水だけでよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 少量でも症状が出るためそばを断り水だけの利用を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Even a small amount causes symptoms for me, so I won't order the soba. Would it be all right to have just water?
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decline the soba because even a small amount causes symptoms, and ask about staying for water only. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 水はお出しできますが、お食事を注文されない場合の利用は店主に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can provide water, but I'll check with the owner whether you can stay without ordering a meal.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お手数ですが、確認をお願いします。難しければ店を出ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 店主への利用確認を依頼し不可なら退出すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Sorry for the trouble, but please check. If it isn't possible, I'll leave.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask them to check with the owner, and say you will leave if it is not allowed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 店主から、今日は水で休んでいただいて構わないと返事がありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The owner says you're welcome to rest here with water today.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では少しだけ休ませてください。材料と器具の両方を調べてくださって助かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 短時間休むことを選び材料と器具の確認への感謝を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll rest for just a little while. Thank you for checking both the ingredients and the utensils; that was very helpful.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose to rest briefly and thank them for checking the ingredients and utensils. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お水をこちらに置きます。お帰りの際も、どうぞお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll put your water here. Please take care when you leave as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お菓子はご自宅用ですか、お土産用ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are the sweets for home or for gifts?

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 職場の十二人に配ります。休憩時間がばらばらなので、個包装のお菓子を探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 十二人に時間差で配るため個包装の菓子を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'll share them among twelve people at work. Our break times are all different, so I'm looking for individually wrapped sweets.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for individually wrapped sweets to give twelve people at different times. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは十二個入りですが、中の包装は三個ずつです。隣は一個ずつで十六個入りです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: This box has twelve, but they're wrapped in groups of three inside. The one next to it has sixteen, each individually wrapped.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一個ずつのほうにします。明後日渡すのですが、開封前の保存方法を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一個ずつ包装された箱を選び明後日までの保存方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll take the individually wrapped ones. I'll give them out the day after tomorrow; could you explain how to store them before opening?
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose the individually wrapped box and ask how to store it until the day after tomorrow. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 箱には直射日光と高温多湿を避けて保存するよう記載があります。期限もこちらをご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: The box says to store them away from direct sunlight, heat, and humidity. Please check the expiry date here too.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 期限は十分ありますね。常温の部屋で保管しますが、一箱はいくらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 期限を確認し常温保管する予定と箱の価格確認を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: There's plenty of time before they expire. I'll keep them in a room at normal temperature. How much is one box?
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the expiry date, say you plan to store them at room temperature, and ask the price per box. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 十六個入りは千八百円です。小分け用の袋も必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: The box of sixteen is eighteen hundred yen. Do you need small bags for handing them out?

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 袋は不要です。箱を職場に置き、各自一個ずつ取ってもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 小分け袋を断り職場で各自に取ってもらう方法を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: No bags, thank you. I'll put the box at work and have everyone take one each.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decline small bags and explain that everyone will take a sweet themselves at work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 千八百円のお会計をお願いします。手提げ袋もお持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: That will be eighteen hundred yen, please. Do you have a carrier bag too?

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 千八百円ちょうど出します。この手提げに、箱を平らに入れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 千八百円ちょうどを払い持参手提げへ箱を平らに入れるよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Here's exactly eighteen hundred yen. Please put the box flat in this carrier bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Pay exactly eighteen hundred yen and ask them to put the box flat in the bag you brought. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 平らに入れました。職場の皆様にもよろしくお伝えください、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've put it in flat. Please give my regards to everyone at your workplace. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのお米を含めて、合計三千四百円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Including this rice, the total is thirty-four hundred yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: お米は棚に二千円と書かれていたと思いますが、レジでは二千四百円になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 米のレジ価格と棚で見た価格の差を指摘する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought the rice was marked two thousand yen on the shelf, but it's twenty-four hundred yen at the register.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Point out the difference between the rice price at the register and the shelf price you saw. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 棚の表示を確認しますので、この袋を少しお預かりしてよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check the shelf label. May I take this bag for a moment?

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、お願いします。五キロの棚の左側から取りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 確認のため米を渡し五キロ棚の左側から取ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, please. I took it from the left side of the five-kilogram shelf.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Hand over the rice for checking and explain that you took it from the left side of the five-kilogram shelf. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 左側の値札は別の銘柄の価格でした。こちらの袋は二千四百円で間違いありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: The price label on the left was for a different brand. This bag is correctly priced at twenty-four hundred yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 銘柄を見間違えたんですね。今日は予算を超えるので、お米だけ取り消してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 銘柄の見間違いを認め予算超過の米だけ取り消しを依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I misread the brand, then. It would put me over my budget today, so please cancel just the rice.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that you mixed up the brands and ask to cancel only the rice because it exceeds your budget. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お米を取り消すと、残りは千円です。ほかの商品はこのままでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Without the rice, the remaining total is one thousand yen. Would you still like the other items?

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 残りの卵と野菜は買います。千円札で払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 卵と野菜の購入を続け千円札で支払うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll buy the eggs and vegetables that are left. I'll pay with a thousand-yen note.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will still buy the eggs and vegetables and pay with a thousand-yen note. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 千円ちょうどお預かりします。卵を入れる袋はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: That's exactly one thousand yen, thank you. Do you have a bag for the eggs?

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 持ってきた袋の上に卵を載せます。訂正後のレシートも受け取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 持参袋の上に卵を置く予定と訂正済みレシートの受取りを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll put the eggs on top in the bag I brought. I'll take the corrected receipt too.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you will put the eggs on top in your own bag and take the corrected receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 訂正後のレシートです。卵にお気をつけてお持ち帰りください、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is the corrected receipt. Please take care with the eggs on your way home. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 包装を始める前に、手袋の状態をもう一度見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before you start packaging, please check your gloves again.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 右手の人差し指に小さな穴があります。まだ食品には触れていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 右人差し指の手袋の穴と食品への未接触を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: There's a small hole over my right index finger. I haven't touched any food yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the hole over your right index finger and that you have not touched food. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 作業を始めず、その位置で待ってください。手袋を着けてから何に触りましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please stay where you are without starting work. What have you touched since putting the gloves on?

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 包装台の端と空のトレーに触りました。食品を載せたトレーには触れていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 包装台の端と空トレーだけに触れたと接触範囲を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I touched the edge of the packaging table and an empty tray. I haven't touched any trays with food on them.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the contact area: only the table edge and an empty tray. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 触れた台と空のトレーを責任者に伝えます。今はその二つを使わないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll tell the supervisor about the table and empty tray you touched. Please don't use either for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 右手の手袋を外す前に、破れた部分が残っているか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 手袋を外す前に破損部分の欠落を調べたいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Before I take the right glove off, I'd like to check whether any of the damaged material is missing.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to check for missing glove material before removing it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認しますと、裂け目はありますが、欠けた部分は見当たりません。この状態も責任者に報告します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: I've checked, and there's a tear, but I can't see any missing pieces. I'll report that condition to the supervisor too.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 片が落ちた様子はないのですね。それでも、包装を再開していいか責任者に聞いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 欠落が見えなくても責任者に再開可否を確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: So there doesn't appear to be a piece that fell off. Even so, please ask the supervisor whether I can restart packaging.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for the supervisor's approval to resume even though no missing material is visible. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 責任者から、台とトレーの確認が済むまで待つよう指示がありました。交換と手洗いは掲示の手順で行ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: The supervisor says to wait until the table and tray have been checked. Please follow the posted procedure for replacing gloves and washing your hands.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 手順に沿って手洗いと交換を済ませ、再開の指示が出るまで包装には戻りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 手洗いと交換後も指示が出るまで包装へ戻らないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll wash my hands and change gloves according to the procedure, and I won't return to packaging until I'm told to resume.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will not return to packaging until instructed, even after washing your hands and changing gloves. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでお願いします。確認が終わったらこちらから知らせますので、いったん失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do that. I'll let you know when the check is finished, so I'll leave you for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 浴衣はお買い求めですか、レンタルのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking to buy a yukata or ask about renting one?

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 夕方の集まりに着るため借りたいです。身長が百五十五センチなので、丈が心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夕方用の浴衣レンタルを希望し身長と丈の不安を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to rent one for an evening gathering. I'm a hundred and fifty-five centimeters tall, so I'm worried about the length.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to rent a yukata for the evening and explain your height and concern about the length. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらには短めと標準丈があります。まず羽織って比べてみませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We have shorter and standard lengths here. Would you like to try them on loosely and compare?

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 短めを羽織ってみます。これだけで裾の位置は決まるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 短めを試し羽織るだけで裾位置が決まるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll try the shorter one. Does simply putting it on determine where the hem will fall?
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Try the shorter yukata and ask whether wearing it loosely determines the hem position. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 実際には帯を締める際に丈を調整するので、羽織るだけでは仕上がりと違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The length is actually adjusted when the obi is tied, so just slipping it on looks different from the finished fit.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分で着付けができません。着付けも一緒に頼めるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分では着付けできないため着付けサービスを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can't dress myself in it. I'd like to know whether I can also ask for a dressing service.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about a dressing service because you cannot put on the yukata yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今日は着付け担当者が戻る時刻を確認する必要があります。何時までに出発なさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We need to check when the person who does the dressing will return today. What time do you need to leave by?

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 五時には店を出たいです。それに間に合わなければ、今回は借りずに帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 五時の出発期限と間に合わなければ借りない判断を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to leave the shop by five. If it won't be ready in time, I won't rent one this time and will head home.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give your five-o'clock departure deadline and say you will not rent if it cannot be ready in time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当者から、四時半に始めて四時五十分までに終えられると返事がありました。料金と返却条件はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: They've replied that they can start at four thirty and finish by four fifty. Here are the fees and return conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 五時に出られることと、明日返せることを確認できました。この短めの浴衣を予約します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 出発と翌日返却の条件を確認し短めの浴衣を予約する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've confirmed that I can leave by five and return it tomorrow. I'll reserve this shorter yukata.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the departure and next-day return conditions and reserve the shorter yukata. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 短めの浴衣をお取り置きします。四時半にお待ちしておりますので、いったんお気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll hold the shorter yukata for you. We'll be expecting you at four thirty. Have a safe trip home for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 改札で止まったカードですね。画面には何と表示されましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is the card that wouldn't work at the gate, correct? What did the screen say?

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 「係員にお知らせください」と出ました。チャージ不足だと思って窓口に来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 改札の係員案内表示を伝え残高不足だと思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: It said, ‘Please contact a member of staff.’ I thought the balance was too low, so I came to the counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the gate's instruction to contact staff and explain that you thought the balance was too low. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 確認すると、前回の出場記録がありません。前にこのカードを使ったのはいつでしょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I've checked, and there is no record of your previous exit. When did you last use this card?

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日の夕方です。有人の出口を通ったので、タッチしなかったかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 前日の利用時刻と有人出口で未タッチだった可能性を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yesterday evening. I went through a staffed exit, so I may not have tapped the card.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the time of yesterday's journey and say you may not have tapped at the staffed exit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 昨日の乗車区間を確認する必要があります。どの駅からどの駅までですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We need to check yesterday's journey. Which station did you travel from and to?

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 乗った駅と降りた駅を、このメモに書きました。順番に読んでいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 前日に利用した乗車駅と降車駅を記したメモを見せて確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've written the boarding and exit stations on this note. Could you read them in order?
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the note of yesterday's boarding and exit stations and ask for confirmation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この区間ですね。運賃の処理とカードの記録を確認してから、お支払いが必要かご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: This journey, then. We'll check the fare processing and card records before telling you whether you need to pay.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二重に払うのが心配です。昨日の運賃が引かれているかも調べてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二重払いの不安を伝え前日の運賃引落し履歴も調べてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'm worried about paying twice. Please also check whether yesterday's fare has already been deducted.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain your concern about double payment and ask them to check yesterday's fare deduction history too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 履歴と照合しますので、今はチャージせずにお待ちください。カードはこちらでお預かりして構いませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll compare it with the history, so please wait without topping up for now. May we keep your card here while we check?

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認が済むまで預けます。追加の入金はせず、こちらのベンチで待っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: カードを預け追加チャージせずベンチで待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll leave it with you until the check is complete. I won't add any money, and I'll wait on this bench.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Leave your card with staff and say you will wait on the bench without topping up. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。確認後にお呼びしますので、いったん失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll call you after checking, so please excuse me for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 皆様おそろいでしょうか。先にお飲み物を伺いましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is everyone here? Shall I take your drink orders first?

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一人が二十分ほど遅れます。私たち二人にはお茶を、料理は冷ややっこだけお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一人の二十分の遅刻を伝え先の二人分の茶と冷ややっこを注文する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: One person will be about twenty minutes late. Tea for the two of us here, and just chilled tofu for food, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that one person will be twenty minutes late and order tea and chilled tofu for the two already present. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お茶二つと冷ややっこですね。温かい料理は後になさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Two teas and chilled tofu, then. Would you like the hot dishes later?

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 焼き魚を頼むつもりですが、三人そろってから焼き始めてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 三人がそろうまで焼き魚の調理開始を待ってほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: We're planning to order grilled fish, but could you wait to start grilling it until all three of us are here?
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask them to wait until all three people arrive before starting to cook the grilled fish. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 先のご注文を保留しておきます。到着されましたら、焼き始めてよいか声をかけてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll keep that order on hold. When your companion arrives, please tell us whether we can start grilling.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 魚はまだ焼かないのですね。遅れる人がもっとかかる場合、保留を取り消せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 魚の未調理を確認し遅刻延長時の保留取消し可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: So you won't grill the fish yet. If the late person takes even longer, can we cancel the order on hold?
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that the fish has not been cooked and ask whether you can cancel the held order if the delay grows. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 調理を始める前でしたら、この注文は取り消せます。今は厨房にも保留と伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can cancel this order before we start cooking. I'll tell the kitchen to hold it for now too.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: それなら安心です。合流したら私から声をかけますので、今は魚を出さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 合流時に自分から合図し現時点では魚を出さないよう依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: That's reassuring. I'll call you when they join us, so please don't serve the fish for now.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will signal when everyone has joined and ask them not to serve the fish yet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 先にお茶と冷ややっこをお持ちしました。取り皿は二枚でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here are your tea and chilled tofu first. Will two small sharing plates be enough?

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今は二枚で十分です。三枚目は同僚が着いてからお願いするので、まず二人でいただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今は取り皿二枚を希望し三枚目は合流後に頼むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Two are enough for now. I'll ask for the third when my coworker arrives, so the two of us will start eating first.
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for two sharing plates now and say you will request a third after your companion arrives. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二枚お置きします。お連れ様の到着後にまた伺いますので、それではごゆっくり。
DLG-SC-LOC-SMN-IZUMO-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll put two here. I'll check again after your companion arrives. Please take your time.

DLG-SC-SMN-MASUDA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SMN-MASUDA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この二枚の絵は、同じ場所を描いた組作品なんですよ。
DLG-SC-SMN-MASUDA-001-SHARED-01.translation: These two paintings form a pair depicting the same place.

DLG-SC-SMN-MASUDA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SMN-MASUDA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 右の絵だけ見ていました。左と合わせると何が分かりますか。
DLG-SC-SMN-MASUDA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 組作品の左右を合わせた見方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SMN-MASUDA-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was only looking at the painting on the right. What can I understand by looking at it together with the left one?
DLG-SC-SMN-MASUDA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to view the left and right paintings together as a pair. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SMN-MASUDA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SMN-MASUDA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 左は朝、右は夕方の風景です。どちらも同じ橋が描かれています。
DLG-SC-SMN-MASUDA-001-SHARED-03.translation: The left shows the morning, and the right shows the evening. The same bridge is in both.

DLG-SC-SMN-MASUDA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SMN-MASUDA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 橋は見つかりましたが、朝の絵の川が青くないのはなぜですか。
DLG-SC-SMN-MASUDA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 朝の絵で川が青く描かれていない理由を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SMN-MASUDA-001-SHARED-04.translation: I've found the bridge, but why isn't the river blue in the morning painting?
DLG-SC-SMN-MASUDA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask why the river in the morning painting is not painted blue. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SMN-MASUDA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SMN-MASUDA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 解説では、朝の光を表すために淡い黄色を使ったと説明されています。
DLG-SC-SMN-MASUDA-001-SHARED-05.translation: The commentary says pale yellow was used to convey the morning light.

DLG-SC-SMN-MASUDA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SMN-MASUDA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 「淡い」は、色が薄いという意味でしょうか。
DLG-SC-SMN-MASUDA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 解説の「淡い」の意味を言い換えて確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SMN-MASUDA-001-SHARED-06.translation: Does ‘pale’ mean the color is light?
DLG-SC-SMN-MASUDA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Rephrase the word ‘pale’ from the commentary to check its meaning. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SMN-MASUDA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SMN-MASUDA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その意味で使われています。近くの色と比べると、違いが見えますよ。
DLG-SC-SMN-MASUDA-001-SHARED-07.translation: That's how it's used here. You'll see the difference if you compare it with nearby colors.

DLG-SC-SMN-MASUDA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SMN-MASUDA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 色を比べて覚えたいので、メモ帳に短く書いても構いませんか。
DLG-SC-SMN-MASUDA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 色の比較をメモ帳に記録できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SMN-MASUDA-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to remember by comparing the colors. May I write a short note in my notebook?
DLG-SC-SMN-MASUDA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may record the color comparison in your notebook. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SMN-MASUDA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SMN-MASUDA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 鉛筆でメモしていただけます。作品に近づきすぎず、こちらのベンチでどうぞ。
DLG-SC-SMN-MASUDA-001-SHARED-09.translation: You may take notes in pencil. Please use this bench without getting too close to the artwork.

DLG-SC-SMN-MASUDA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-SMN-MASUDA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ではベンチで朝と夕方の違いをメモしてから、もう一度二枚を見ます。
DLG-SC-SMN-MASUDA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: ベンチで違いを記録した後に組作品を見直すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-SMN-MASUDA-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll note the differences between morning and evening on the bench, and look at both paintings again afterward.
DLG-SC-SMN-MASUDA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will note the differences on the bench and then view the pair again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-SMN-MASUDA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-SMN-MASUDA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それぞれの光を楽しんでくださいね。ごゆっくりどうぞ。
DLG-SC-SMN-MASUDA-001-SHARED-11.translation: Enjoy the different light in each. Please take your time.
